title: docs/derived/state/evidence/*.json — a revision-bound qualifying artifact
description: AUTHORED by a project's tooling, never written by this pack. Every constraint here is ENFORCED at runtime by kernel/lib/state.js loadEvidence(), which records an explicit reason for each rejection. additionalProperties is TRUE: producers legitimately carry tool metadata (`tool`, `toolVersion`, `buildRevision`, `project`, `channel`, `nonClaims`) the kernel does not read. ⛔ `file` is INJECTED by the loader and must not be authored.

schemaVersion.description: Hard-checked. An unknown version is REJECTED with its reason, never read on a best-effort basis.

requirements.description: Evidence that claims nothing cannot support anything, so the list may not be empty.

sourceRevision.description: Unbound evidence cannot be known to have tested anything; evidence bound to a superseded revision stops counting (R-6).

positiveControl.description: A battery whose known-good control did not pass proves the harness runs, not that it can detect anything (DF-007 #7).

negativeControl.description: A battery whose known-bad control was never detected discriminates nothing.

partial.description: A partial battery is reported separately and never promoted to gate completion.

qualifiedBy.description: `independent` is the only value with meaning: a high-risk row cannot reach `conformant` on the implementer's own qualification (R-3).
